fact: Every SISU cushion is filled with a duck feather insert, and the insert is included with the cover.
source: Product descriptions and the custom.insert metafield on every product (Storefront API, 2026-11-05)

fact: The duck feather inserts are made in the Netherlands.
source: Product descriptions ("Dutch duck feather insert", "made in the Netherlands")

fact: The inserts are certified to DOWNPASS, an independent standard for the origin and traceability of down and feather.
The inserts are OEKO-TEX STANDARD 100 certified, which means they have been tested for harmful substances. This is not an allergy test, and SISU does not call its inserts hypoallergenic.
A 50 x 50 cm SISU cover comes with a 55 cm insert. The insert is deliberately larger than the cover so the cushion looks full.
source: Product descriptions of the 50 x 50 cm cushions

fact: The insert size used in the 60 x 40 cm covers.
source: Not stated on any product page; awaiting Jessie

fact: Every cover closes with a concealed Opti zip.
source: Construction facts supplied by Jessie (pipeline ticket, 2026-11-05)

fact: Covers are sewn with 1.5 cm seams.
source: Construction facts supplied by Jessie (pipeline ticket, 2026-11-05)

fact: The fringing on SISU cushions is 100% cotton, except Gaia, whose trim details say 100% polyester. Do not make a general claim about fringe material without a confirm marker.
source: Construction facts supplied by Jessie; custom.trim metafields. Gaia's trim metafield says 100% Polyester, so check per product.

fact: SISU recommends spot cleaning the covers.
source: custom.care metafield on every product ("Spot clean recommended")

fact: Each cushion is cut and sewn in small batches in Amsterdam.
source: Product descriptions ("cut and sewn in small batches in Amsterdam")

fact: The fabrics are deadstock and surplus from leading interior brands, bought from EU suppliers including Wasted Fabrics, EVA re-source and Fabric Sight.
source: Construction facts supplied by Jessie (pipeline ticket, 2026-11-05); product descriptions

fact: Because of the fabric cut, pattern placement varies on each cushion, so no two are exactly alike.
Once a deadstock fabric is used up it is not restocked.
Delivery is free in the Netherlands.
source: Product descriptions ("Free delivery in the Netherlands")
